heading: Demo data
description: Adds about 30 days of sample check-ins and 3 sample screenings so you can explore charts and insights. Everything is labelled Demo. Your own entries are never changed. You can remove it at any time.
loadedHelp: Sample rows are labelled Demo wherever they appear. They stay in your own account and are never shown to counsellors or your institution.
confirmBody: This removes only the sample data. Your own entries stay.
loadSuccess: Demo data loaded: {{moods}} sample check-ins and {{assessments}} sample screenings.
clearSuccess: Demo data cleared: {{moods}} sample check-ins and {{assessments}} sample screenings removed. Your own entries were not changed.
errorLoad: Demo data could not be loaded. Nothing was added. Please try again.
errorClear: Demo data could not be cleared. Nothing was removed. Please try again.
errorStatus: Could not check whether demo data is loaded.
errorAuth: Please sign in again to use demo data.
errorUnavailable: Demo data is not available on this server yet.
previewTitle: This preview already uses sample data
previewBody: You are in the offline preview, which shows sample content without a backend. Sign in with a real account to add labelled demo data to it.
